name: Octopus
intro: An octopus is a soft sea animal with 8 arms. It is very good at hiding.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: An octopus has a soft, round body.
It has 8 long arms.
Its arms are covered with suckers.
It has no bones.
Its mouth has a hard beak, like a parrot.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Octopuses live in oceans all over the world.
Many live on the ocean floor.
An octopus lives alone in a home called a den.
It likes to squeeze into small spaces between rocks.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Octopuses eat crabs, shrimp, and lobsters.
They also eat clams and fish.
An octopus uses its suckers to pull food to its mouth.
The giant Pacific octopus hunts mostly at night.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A mother octopus lays many, many eggs.
She hangs the eggs from the roof of her den.
She cleans the eggs and keeps them safe.
Some baby octopuses hatch from eggs as small as rice.
Most octopuses live only one or two years.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: An octopus has three hearts.
Its blood is blue.
It can change color to hide.
It can squirt ink to get away.
Octopuses are very smart and can open jars.

vocab.meaning: A round part that sticks to things.
